buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get Detailed Design Drawings approved from buyer before starting fabrication. Successful Bidder shall submit Detailed Design Drawings for Buyer's approval, within 5 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, either approve the drawings or will provide complete list of modification required in the drawings within 7 days. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved Drawings with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of drawing– the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in approval of Drawing. 2. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 1 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Generic

Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 5. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 6. Generic For hazardous chemical/item, all precautionary measure as per regulation from the point of transportation/ handling/ storage/ safety/ health/ environment to be undertaken/ specified before dispatch. During dispatch, proper symbol for the hazard/ MSDS/ Batch No./ date of manufacturing/ Gross Weight/ Net Weight/ shelf Life etc are to be written/ printed/ pasted on the body of the packing. 7. Financial Criteria NET WORTH: Net Worth of the OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Document required from seller - (a) Experience criteria (b) Past performance (c) Bidder Turnover (d) Certificate (request in ATC) duly signed and firm stamp (e) OEM Annual Turnover 2. The bidder should have valid registration for Central Excise, Sales Tax, CST, GST, Udyam Adhaar and inc ome Tax PAN). Copies of Valid registration certificates for all above statutory registrations should be submi tted. 3. The bidder should have not been debarred/ blacklisted by any Government/ Quasi-Government/ Public S ector Undertaking/ Defence establishment/ Police Department of India. A self-certificate in court affidavit t his regard to be submitted by the order. 4. Original product brochure/ catalogue to be submitted alongwith bid documents quotation (bids withouto riginal product information will not be considered). 5. TEC documents must be duly signed and stamped for acceptance of all terms and conditions. 6. Bid of the firm will be rejected on non-submission of any documents sought in this bid. 7. Terms of Delivery. All items are to be supplied at the Garhwal Rifles Regimental Centre, Lansdowne with in the Stipulated delivery period under the arrangement of supplier for which no additional cost shall be bo rne by the purchaser. 8. Technical literature of items quoted to be submitted by the bidder. 9. Technical catalogue of the items to be quoted by the bidder alongwith their specifications.

10. Bid cannot be split. 11. A firm/ company of bidder should be constituted as per norms of Govt. of India having valid and active GSTIN etc. 12. Tender Condition Acceptance Certificate to be signed and stamped and scanned copy to be uploaded b y the vendor. 13. Non discloser certificate. 14. 60% of the past performance for the similar item, for the total value of the tender should be submitted by the bidder. 15. Bid security declaration by MSME requesting for exemption. 16. A certificate regarding non black list by Govt organisation etc. 17. The bidder shall provide a physical sample of the quoted item as and when required by the Buyer/Tech nical Evaluation Committee for verification of quality, workmanship, material, construction and conformity with the specified technical parameters. Non-submission of the required sample within the stipulated time shall render the bidder technically non-compliant and liable for rejection. 18. All pages to be signed by an authorised person of the company with official stamp. .
